operating_notes.text: Over 55% of revenue comes from pallet pooling, with the balance mainly from FLC/crates and MHE allotment; pallet utilisation was over 87% during FY23-FY26.
Combined asset base of pallets, FLCs, crates, utility boxes and MHEs was about 14.9 million as of June 2026 (June 2025: 13.7 million).
Average customer agreement runs three to five years with in-built escalation clauses; KKR held 35.11% as of August 2026.
Incorporated Vimprotech Private Limited and Total Integrated Packaging Solutions Limited as wholly owned subsidiaries in October 2026.
